_comment: Mnemonic for each non-neutral type matchup. Key = 'attacker>defender'. The attacker is always the subject of the sentence (simple SVO). Type-coded vocab (spark/flame/frost/current) is reserved for its own type — e.g. only electric uses 'current', only fire uses 'flame'.
normal>rock: Normal hits bounce off solid stone.
normal>ghost: Normal attacks pass right through ghosts.
fire>fire: Fire can't burn itself any hotter.
fire>rock: Fire warms stone but can't crack it.
fire>steel: Fire melts steel in the forge.
water>grass: Water nourishes plants instead of hurting them.
water>ground: Water floods dry ground into mud.
electric>electric: Electricity can't shock a live wire.
electric>grass: Electricity grounds out through plant roots.
electric>ground: Electricity sinks straight into the ground.
electric>flying: Electricity strikes anything in the sky.
grass>grass: Grass tangles with grass but doesn't cut.
grass>poison: Grass attacks slide right off poison types.
grass>flying: Grass vines can't reach the sky.
grass>bug: Grass feeds bugs instead of hurting them.
grass>rock: Grass roots crack boulders over time.
grass>steel: Grass leaves can't dull a blade.
ice>flying: Ice grounds birds with freezing wind.
fighting>normal: Fighting lands clean on ordinary bodies.
fighting>poison: Fighting can't punch a cloud of venom.
fighting>flying: Fighting can't reach birds in the sky.
fighting>bug: Fighting struggles to hit tiny fast bugs.
fighting>rock: Fighting cracks boulders with martial strikes.
fighting>ghost: Fighting's fists pass through empty air.
fighting>steel: Fighting dents armor with trained strikes.
poison>ground: Poison sinks into dirt and diffuses.
poison>rock: Poison can't seep into solid stone.
ground>electric: Ground drains every current to zero.
ground>grass: Ground feeds plants instead of hurting them.
ground>poison: Ground crushes poison into the dirt.
ground>flying: Ground can't kick birds out of the sky.
ground>bug: Ground tremors miss bugs that fly or hide.
flying>electric: Flying gusts barely faze electric types.
flying>grass: Flying wings slash through tall grass.
flying>fighting: Flying strikes from above before fists connect.
flying>bug: Flying birds eat bugs for breakfast.
psychic>fighting: Psychic mind tricks stop the muscle.
psychic>psychic: Psychic minds cancel each other out.
psychic>dark: Psychic can't read a guarded dark mind.
psychic>steel: Psychic thought barely stirs cold metal.
bug>poison: Bugs can't bite through poison's thick hide.
bug>flying: Bugs can't hurt their own natural predators.
bug>psychic: Bugs break concentration with skittering chaos.
bug>steel: Bugs bend their pincers on steel plate.
rock>fighting: Rocks glance off a fighter's solid stance.
rock>ground: Rocks thud harmlessly into soft earth.
rock>flying: Rocks clip birds out of the sky.
rock>steel: Rocks turn aside against steel plate.
ghost>normal: Ghosts can't haunt someone who doesn't believe.
ghost>dark: Ghosts can't startle someone who expects tricks.
dark>fighting: Dark tricks bounce off honorable fighters.
dark>ghost: Dark preys on the spirits that prey on others.
dark>dark: Dark schemers see each other coming.
dark>fairy: Dark can't hide from fairy light.
steel>fire: Steel blades laugh at forge heat.
steel>water: Steel cools in water, doesn't break.
steel>steel: Steel blades just ring off each other.
steel>fairy: Steel is the cold iron that banishes fae.
fairy>dragon: Fairies slay dragons in every legend.
fairy>steel: Fairy magic can't bend cold iron.
